text:
```yaml
name: Clang Static Analyzer

on:
  pull_request:
    branches:
      - main
      - master

permissions:
  contents: read

jobs:
  clang-analyzer:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    container:
      image: ghcr.io/rsyslog/devcontainer:latest
      options: --user root
    steps:
      - name: Checkout code
        uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Install dependencies
        run: |
          apt-get update
          apt-get install -y clang-tools build-essential autoconf automake libtool pkg-config

      - name: Configure
        run: |
          autoreconf -fi
          ./configure --enable-static --disable-shared

      - name: Run Clang Static Analyzer
        run: |
          scan-build --status-bugs make -j$(nproc)
        continue-on-error: true

      - name: Upload scan-build reports
        if: always()
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@v4
        with:
          name: clang-analyzer-reports
          path: scan-build-report
          retention-days: 7

      - name: Log artifact URL
        if: always()
        run: |
          echo "Clang Static Analyzer reports uploaded. Check the artifacts tab for 'clang-analyzer-reports'."
```
